decontamination_notes: Real bug fix from agronholm/anyio PR #1234, merged 2026-07-19, after the training cutoffs of the models this suite targets; re-check upstream_merged against any newer model's cutoff before reusing. TaskGroup.create_task defaulted the task name to the coroutine's bare __qualname__, while start_soon/start name tasks module-qualified via get_callable_name — the same work got different names depending on the spawning spelling. The fix spans three files across both backends (system complexity): abc/_tasks.py adds get_coro_name (module from cr_frame.f_globals joined with the qualname, override wins, graceful fallback), and _backends/_asyncio.py and _backends/_trio.py thread it through their create_task paths. Repo sliced at the PR base commit (2ba69a64) to LICENSE + pyproject.toml + src (same slicing as the python-1 anyio tasks); runtime deps come from the existing per-task image vulcanbench/sandbox:anyio-1191 (sniffio/idna/typing_extensions/pytest-asyncio/trio; anyio itself overlaid via PYTHONPATH=src). Coverage: 3 fail_to_pass tests, each verified failing at base and passing after the gold patch — module-qualified default names on the asyncio and trio backends (asserted via the public TaskHandle.name against __name__ + __qualname__ computed in the test module itself), and agreement with start_soon's convention; 4 pass_to_pass guards pin explicit name= override, start_soon's already-module-qualified naming, awaiting the handle's result, and the trio backend running at all. No assertions on error or repr text beyond the name value.
